title: 第12章 发烧
slug: 重生七零逆袭路全本免费-重生七零逆袭路最新章节列表
content_zh:
“哟～我的小九儿，怎么哭了？是不是想舅舅了呀？”赵国辉想起侄女遭的罪，心中一酸，蹲下身子逗起侄女来。
今天的周园园，穿着一件大红色的粗线毛衣外套，毛衣是开襟的，赵芸香手巧，织了一个时髦的小翻领。小翻领的边缘被赵芸香用白色的开司米线勾出了一条狗牙花边，衬的小女孩的小圆脸像是一只红苹果一般可爱。
周园园出生的时候胖乎乎的，足足有九斤重，所以赵庆山给她取了个小名叫小九。
现在的周园园，没有小时候那样胖了。圆圆的脸蛋修长了些，弯弯的柳叶眉下，是一双黑漆漆的杏仁大眼。女孩专注看东西的时候，眼睛里一片雾蒙蒙的，平添几分柔嫩。
“舅舅，抱。”周园园伸出双手，和赵国辉表示亲近。每次去外公家，外公和舅舅都很喜欢逗她，让园园相信自己是外公和舅舅最喜欢的宝贝。
窝在赵国辉宽阔的胸膛上，感受着赵国辉身上的温度，这一瞬间，周园园觉得很安心。
站在旁边这么久，周园园觉得又冷又累，要不是不放心妈妈，她很想回房间好好睡一觉。
“呀！园园身上怎么这么烫？”赵国辉抱着软软萌萌的小人儿，觉得不对劲，伸出手一摸，周园园额头上的温度让他吓了一大跳。
发烧了！
这个年代，发烧不退烧成白痴的病例多的是。
赵芸香和赵国辉心中大急，顾不上一旁陪着笑脸的周春平，抱起园园就往门外冲。
赵芸香接过赵国辉手里的园园，眼泪一直流个不停。
都是她这个当妈的没用，才让孩子遭了罪。一大早的，孩子身体还没好，硬是在身旁陪着，怕她吃了亏。她怎么就没注意到园园的不对劲呢？婆婆找茬不理她就好了，她怎么就光顾着和婆婆攀扯了呢？要是园园有什么万一，她······她也不活算了。
周园园脸蛋烧的通红，鼻尖里闻着赵芸香身上的馨香，觉得异常安心。
老天爷垂怜，让她重活一次，见到了妈妈，见到了舅舅，就算是现在死掉，她也赚到了。
周园园傻呵呵地笑着，攥着赵芸香衣角的手渐渐地松开，陷入了昏迷中。
“园园，园园！”赵芸香大惊失色，声音中带上了几分凄厉。
“姐，快上车。”赵国辉骑着自行车，追上了奔跑中的赵芸香。
赵芸香憋着劲，跳上了自行车的后座。光靠着她的两腿跑，跑到镇上还不知道什么时候呢！
周春平见赵芸香姐弟俩抱着园园一路疾驰而去，心中“咯噔”一下，暗叫了声“不好”。

三儿媳和亲家小舅子这么一咋呼，周春平看见好几家邻居伸出头来看了热闹。完了完了，这下子，他周家要被全村人拿来说嘴了。
小小年纪心肠歹毒推堂妹落水，苗苗这件事算是遮盖不住了。这样一来，谁还会和他们家往来？
他周春平在周家村一直是让人羡慕的存在，就算是周家村的村长，也会给他几分面子。这件丑事一张扬出去，他周春平以后在那帮庄稼汉面前，怎么挺的直腰杆啊？
周春平急得团团转。
“老头子，你怎么了？”吴金凤见周春平突然间脸色难看的厉害，急忙问了句。
周春平拉长了脸，不想回答吴金凤这句略显蠢笨的问话。事情明摆在那里，老婆子不用脑子想想，光知道问，真是头发长见识短的村妇。
怎么了怎么了？他周春平考虑到是整个周家，只有老太婆这种眼光短浅的，才老抓住当年那件事不放。
今天小九那丫头这么一晕，他这个做爷爷的说不得要拿点钱出来，给孩子看病吃药买补品，才能堵得住村里人的说嘴。
一想起好不容易攒的百来块钱要少上一叠，周春平的心就有着说不出的痛。
“老二，老二家的，苗苗，你们出来一下。”周春平越想越气，直接吼出了声。照他看来，老二一家都是欠收拾。老二懒得要死，老二媳妇眼窝子比老太婆还浅，教出来两个孩子，大的心肠不好，小的唯唯诺诺。他周春平什么命哟～！摊上了老二这个不像样的儿子。
“老头子，你怎么了？你可别吓我啊！”吴金凤见周春平双目圆睁，张着嘴大声喘着气，不由得吓了一跳。
“咳咳咳······呸！都是你惯的！”周春平咳出一口痰，这才横了吴金凤一眼，骂道：“老娘们家家的，一天到晚只知道东家长西家短，家里的儿孙都不知道管管，看看老二，看看苗苗，歪成啥样了？”

content_en:
"Hey, my little Jiu'er, why are you crying? Do you miss your uncle?" Zhao Guohui felt sad when he thought of his niece's misfortune, and he knelt down to tease his niece.
Today, Zhou Yuanyuan is wearing a bright red thick-threaded sweater jacket. The sweater is open-fronted. Zhao Yunxiang has a skillful hand and has knitted a fashionable small lapel. Zhao Yunxiang used white cashmere thread to draw a dog-tooth lace around the edge of the lapel, which made the little girl's round face look as cute as a red apple.
Zhou Yuanyuan was chubby when she was born, weighing nine pounds, so Zhao Qingshan nicknamed her Xiaojiu.
Now Zhou Yuanyuan is not as fat as she was when she was a child. The round face is longer and longer, and under the curved willow eyebrows are a pair of big dark almond eyes. When the girl focused on looking at something, her eyes were misty, making her look a little softer.
"Uncle, hug." Zhou Yuanyuan stretched out his hands to express his closeness to Zhao Guohui. Every time she goes to her grandpa's house, her grandpa and uncle like to tease her, making Yuanyuan believe that she is their favorite baby.
Nestling on Zhao Guohui's broad chest and feeling the warmth of Zhao Guohui's body, Zhou Yuanyuan felt at ease at this moment.
After standing there for so long, Zhou Yuanyuan felt cold and tired. If she hadn't worried about her mother, she would have wanted to go back to the room and have a good sleep.
"Ah! Why is Yuanyuan so hot?" Zhao Guohui hugged the soft and cute little person and felt something was wrong. He stretched out his hand and touched it. He was shocked by the temperature on Zhou Yuanyuan's forehead.
Got a fever!
In this day and age, there are many cases of people becoming idiots due to fever that does not subside.
Zhao Yunxiang and Zhao Guohui were so anxious that they couldn't care less about the smiling Zhou Chunping beside them. They picked up Yuanyuan and rushed out the door.
Zhao Yunxiang took the Yuanyuan from Zhao Guohui's hands, and her tears kept flowing.
It was all because she was a useless mother that the child suffered. It was early in the morning, and the child was not well yet, so he stayed with her, fearing that she would suffer a disadvantage. Why didn't she notice something was wrong with Yuanyuan? It would be fine if her mother-in-law found trouble and ignored her. Why did she just keep arguing with her mother-in-law? If anything happens to Yuanyuan, she... she won't survive.
Zhou Yuanyuan's face was burning red, and he smelled the sweet fragrance of Zhao Yunxiang in his nose, feeling extremely relieved.
God took pity on her and allowed her to live her life again. She could see her mother and her uncle. Even if she dies now, she has earned something.
Zhou Yuanyuan smiled stupidly, and gradually loosened her grip on Zhao Yunxiang's clothes, falling into a coma.
"Yuanyuan, Yuanyuan!" Zhao Yunxiang was shocked, with a bit of sadness in her voice.
"Sister, get in the car quickly." Zhao Guohui rode his bicycle and caught up with Zhao Yunxiang who was running.
Zhao Yunxiang held back her energy and jumped on the back seat of the bicycle. Just relying on her legs to run, I don't know how long it will take to reach the town!
When Zhou Chunping saw Zhao Yunxiang and his brother running away with Yuanyuan in their arms, his heart thumped, and he secretly shouted, "Not good."
When the third daughter-in-law and brother-in-law yelled like this, Zhou Chunping saw several neighbors sticking their heads out to watch the excitement. It's over, it's over, now, his Zhou family will be talked about by the whole village.
At a young age, she was vicious and pushed her cousin into the water. Miaomiao could not hide this incident. In this case, who would interact with their family?
He, Zhou Chunping, has always been an enviable existence in Zhoujia Village. Even the head of Zhoujia Village will give him some face. If this scandal is spread out, how can he, Zhou Chunping, stand tall in front of those farmers?
Zhou Chunping was anxious.
"Old man, what's wrong with you?" Wu Jinfeng asked hurriedly when he saw that Zhou Chunping's face suddenly turned ugly.
Zhou Chunping had a long face, not wanting to answer Wu Jinfeng's slightly stupid question. The matter is obvious. The old woman doesn't need to think about it. She just asks. She is really a village woman with long hair and short knowledge.
What's wrong? What's wrong? He Zhou Chunping considered thatIn the entire Zhou family, only the old woman, who is short-sighted, always clings to that incident.
That girl Xiaojiu was so dizzy today that he, a grandfather, had to spend some money to buy medicines and supplements for his children in order to silence the villagers.
Zhou Chunping felt an indescribable pain in his heart when he thought that the hundred yuan he had finally saved would be reduced by a stack.
"Lao Er, Lao Er's family, Miaomiao, come out for a moment." Zhou Chunping became angrier as he thought about it, and yelled out. According to him, the second child and his family are all in need. The second child is lazy as hell, and his daughter-in-law's eye sockets are shallower than the old woman's. She raised two children, the older one has a bad heart, and the younger one is submissive. What kind of fate does Zhou Chunping have? It's a shameful son like Lao Er.
"Old man, what's wrong with you? Don't scare me!" Wu Jinfeng couldn't help being frightened when she saw Zhou Chunping's eyes wide open and his mouth open, breathing loudly.
"Ahem, cough, cough... Bah! You are used to it!" Zhou Chunping coughed up a mouthful of phlegm, then glanced at Wu Jinfeng, and cursed: "All these ladies, all day long, only know that the east is long and the west is short, and the children and grandchildren at home don't know how to take care of them. Look at the second child, look at Miao Miao, how crooked are they?"
